name: hydra
description: Claude leads, cheaper agents (Heads, on Command Code or CodeBuddy) implement: /hydra turns it on, /heads watches them live, /hydra-usage shows both sides' limits

headModel.title: Hydra head model
headModel.description: Model the Heads run on (CodeBuddy ids have no provider prefix: deepseek-v4.1-flash)

headEngine.title: Hydra head engine
headEngine.description: The CLI Heads run on: commandcode or codebuddy; changeable with /hydra engine=<name>

headEffort.title: Hydra head effort
headEffort.description: auto (the Lead picks per Head: low when it can check the result, one level up per retry) or a level every Head runs at: off, low, medium, high, xhigh or max; changeable with /hydra effort=<level>

headsFiveHourUsd.title: Command Code 5-hour limit (USD)
headsFiveHourUsd.description: Your plan's 5-hour spend cap in USD; 0 shows spend without a limit

headsWeeklyUsd.title: Command Code weekly limit (USD)
headsWeeklyUsd.description: Your plan's weekly spend cap in USD; 0 shows spend without a limit

headsPlan.title: Command Code plan
headsPlan.description: Your Command Code plan name, shown in /hydra-usage (optional)
